l3.text:
The `AttributeError` occurs when a bar is created with `disable=True` and you then call `len()` on it. Here is the chain:

- The early-return `if disable:` branch in `__init__` sets `iterable`, `disable`, `pos` and `n`, but never `self.total`.
- `__len__` falls back to `self.total` when there is no iterable, or when the iterable has neither `shape` nor `__len__`.
- In that case `len()` hits the missing attribute and raises.

The fix stores `total` in the disabled branch as well. I have not run this against a test.

```diff
diff --git a/tqdm/_tqdm.py b/tqdm/_tqdm.py
--- a/tqdm/_tqdm.py
+++ b/tqdm/_tqdm.py
@@ -735,10 +735,11 @@
         if disable:
             self.iterable = iterable
             self.disable = disable
             self.pos = self._get_free_pos(self)
             self._instances.remove(self)
             self.n = initial
+            self.total = total
             return
 
         if kwargs:
             self.disable = True
             self.pos = self._get_free_pos(self)
```
